issues: The verse reports signs and wonders without describing their form; the visual inference should not be rendered as a specific visible event.
Angels' appearance is unspecified; they may be shown appearing, but their visual form should not be invented.
The verse identifies the speakers only as people reasoning and contending; the label “People disputing the prophecies” is a reasonable description, not a source-given name.

The speakers’ claim continues beyond the quoted dialogue: the verse also says the alleged mystery would keep them servants and ignorant if they yielded. Summary captures the gist, but dialogue omits those exact words.
No new scene or chronology is introduced relative to the preceding discussion; the uncertainty is limited to the speakers’ identities and setting.
